title: Corrosive Etcher
body:
Corrosive Etcher is battle axe, which can be used to fight with goblins and skeletons

Details

  1. Corrosive Etcher is an axe, but it can't chop trees
  2. Corrosive Etcher almost oneshots small skeletons
  3. It can one shot gremlins
  4. It deals around three times more damage than the dragonbone

Obtainment

Corrosive Etcher can be bought at goblins village, so you need acid crown to get there
